in_hebrew.name: מִסְתִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'mist', meaning dew or mist, which can symbolize refreshing, newness, or grace.

in_greek.name: Μιστή
in_greek.long_meaning: A name of Greek origin, derived from the word 'mistos', meaning mist or dew. In the New Testament, this name is borne by the sister of Martha and Lazarus.

in_latin.name: Mistia
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Greek name 'Mistē'. It shares the same meaning as the Hebrew and Greek names, symbolizing refreshing, newness, or grace.
